data.title: Pentagon's Parnell says claims of US munitions shortage amid Iran war 'false' | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: "The US has massive amounts of 'munitions'" Trump wrote in a post on Truth Social on August 6, adding that claims of any munitions shortage were fabricated.
